label: H.R. 8781
title: Title IX Clarification Act of 2026

items.snippet: On February 4, 2025, the Department of Education announced its intent to enforce its Title IX regulations consistent with this executive order.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

A000375.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
A000375.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
A000375.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
